problem:
The basis $B$ of ${R}^{3}$ and the matrix $[\,T\,]_{B}$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{3}$ relative to $B$ are given by

$$
B={[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 5\end{aligned}]},\,[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}a & 1 & 5 \\ -3 & b & -5 \\ -\frac{3}{5} & -\frac{1}{5} & c\end{aligned}].
$$

What is the value of $\,a+b+c,\,$ given that  

$$
T([\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}x+y+z \\ x-y \\ x-z\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: The Matrix of a Linear Transformation Relative to a Basis
